say:1:1430122201:0.text: Ha! Good eye! These logs are from Cedartown. The cold weather there breeds good wood. They're more fire-resistant too.
say:1:1430122201:0.source_cn: 眼光不错！这些木材都是从雪松镇运来的，那边天气冷，木材...

say:2:1430122202:0.text: The overseer said that Brimstone Village was brimming with orders so we had to "save production capacity," and forbade me from building a storehouse for these logs.
say:2:1430122202:0.source_cn: 可负责人说深岩村最近在执行什么“节约产能”的命令，不让...

say:3:1430122203:0.text: If it rains and these logs get wet and damaged, who's going to take responsibility?!
say:3:1430122203:0.source_cn: 你说万一下雨导致这些好木材被淋湿，到时候算谁的？
